audiobook.title: Brain Rules
audiobook.author: Dr. John Medina
audiobook.description:
Brain Rules (2008) by Dr. John Medina is a science-backed guide that explains how the human brain functions and how to apply this knowledge to improve work, school, and home life. A molecular biologist, Medina breaks down complex neuroscience into 12 "rules" that describe our brain's core abilities and limitations.
The book's core premise is that modern environments—like high-stress cubicles and sedentary classrooms—are often designed in direct opposition to how our brains evolved to function. By understanding evolutionary biology, we can use our natural impulses to enhance learning, productivity, and health.

latest.title: Better Than Before
latest.author: Gretchen Rubin
latest.description:
Better Than Before (2015) by Gretchen Rubin is a self-help guide that argues the secret to changing habits is self-knowledge. It rejects "one-size-fits-all" solutions, instead offering a framework called the Four Tendencies—Upholder, Questioner, Obliger, and Rebel—to help you identify how you personally respond to expectations.
The book identifies 21 strategies to make or break habits, such as monitoring (tracking behavior), scheduling (setting specific times), and accountability (using external pressure). By understanding your own personality type, you can choose the specific tools that will actually work for your life.
